'''Verpine fiber''' was a material used in [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was manufactured and used by the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Verpine fiber mesh]] and [[Verpine fiber ultramesh]] were made from Verpine fiber.
